subject: API & product analytics vendor alignment — contract/pricing consolidation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@amplitude.com>, sales@segment.com, rafael.mendes@mixpanel.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating analytics renewals and usage alignment

Hi Sara / Rafael / Segment team,

We have a cluster of renewals coming up this quarter across our product and API analytics vendors (Amplitude, Segment, Mixpanel). Before we start formal renewals, I want to explore whether there are practical consolidation options or cross-product discounts that would meaningfully reduce spend and simplify routing for our tracking pipeline.

Quick context: last 12 months our API ingestion footprint spiked (attached CSV) and we expect another ~15% increase driven by new partner integrations. We'd like: 1) a single baseline quote for our current usage, 2) a proposed consolidated commercial model if vendor is open to covering both product and API analytics, and 3) any recommended guardrails for retention/ingestion that affect pricing.

Can each of you share a preliminary commercial worksheet (licenses + ingest + retention) and your suggested next steps by EOD Thursday? Also proposing a 30-min call next week to walk through the numbers — please indicate availability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0182

Attachments: redwood_usage_snapshot_May2026.csv (CSV)

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@amplitude.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amplitude Legal <ops-legal@amplitude.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating analytics renewals and usage alignment

Hi Marissa — thanks for the context and the usage file.

We ran a quick pass and attached a preliminary quote that shows:
- Current bill baseline (monthly) and 12-month projection with the 15% growth assumption.
- Two commercial paths: single-product renewal (product analytics only) vs. unified product+ingest agreement (consolidation discount applied to ingest tiers).

Notes: we can offer a consolidation credit if Redwood agrees to a 12-month committed ingest band, but we need to align on what counts as "API ingestion" vs. event-forwarded via Segment. Also flagging retention tiers: moving from 90 to 30 days for raw events can significantly lower costs but will affect certain historical analyses — happy to model tradeoffs.

I'm available for a 30-min sync on Monday 5/17 between 10–12 PT. If you want legal to prepare a starter SOW, cc'd ops-legal on this thread.

Best,
Sara Kim
Strategic Accounts — Amplitude
sara.kim@amplitude.com

Attachments: amplitude_prelim_quote_May2026.pdf (PDF)

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@mixpanel.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating analytics renewals and usage alignment

Hi Marissa — appreciate the heads-up.

Mixpanel's angle: we can offer an integrated product+API package but typically that requires a 12–24 month term to justify integration and engineering support credits. I attached a short deck with a consolidation option and high-level contract language we usually start from. Two quick asks: do you have a preferred SLA floor for ingest latency, and would Redwood consider a revenue-based metric (events per MAU) for tiering?

I can join the Monday slot if that works for your team.

Cheers,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive — Mixpanel
rafael.mendes@mixpanel.com

Attachments: mixpanel_contract_terms_draft.pdf (PDF)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating analytics renewals and usage alignment

Marissa — thanks for kicking this off. A few internal notes: 1) Finance needs a modeled TCO for single-vendor consolidation vs. best-of-breed (please include projected token/event growth + retention scenarios), 2) Security will evaluate data residency/ingest controls if we consolidate pipeline ownership, and 3) Procurement/legal must see any starter SOWs before we proceed.

Recommended owners: Dylan can run the TCO model (Dylan, can you take the usage CSV + the Amplitude quote and produce a 12-month cost comparison?), Karhtik, please collect any credit/discount history for prior deals — that helps negotiation leverage.

Also be careful on lock-in — if we consolidate, ensure fallback paths are documented (Segment piping, export runbooks).

- Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, sara.kim@amplitude.com, rafael.mendes@mixpanel.com, sales@segment.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating analytics renewals and usage alignment

Thanks everyone for the quick responses. Next steps / owner assignments: 
1) Dylan will produce a 12-month TCO comparing three paths (Amplitude-only, Mixpanel-only, mixed Segment routing) by EOD Friday 5/22 — Dylan, please include sensitivity to retention windows and estimated engineering migration effort.
2) Karthik will pull prior discount history and any PO templates we should reuse; loop in procurement/legal as needed.
3) Vendor asks: Amplitude / Mixpanel / Segment — please upload an editable SOW or term sheet to the shared Drive folder and flag any non-standard clauses (data export fees, SLA credits, termination windows). We will not sign anything without legal review.

I've uploaded a short notes doc and the usage CSV to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b-Analytics-Renewals. Also attaching the vendor PDFs we received.

I'll schedule the suggested 30-min sync for Monday 5/24 10:30 PT if that works for the vendor participants — calendar invite to follow.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Ops Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments in thread: redwood_usage_snapshot_May2026.csv, amplitude_prelim_quote_May2026.pdf, mixpanel_contract_terms_draft.pdf, segment_consolidation_option.pdf
